documented_probe: C-109de97f (build a serial de bruijn graph assembler): reference floor is hard but the covering task exercises it at medium; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases. Documented probe waiver.
notes: Greedy shortest-common-superstring assembly. Core difficulty is reasoning_depth: the exact merge rule (max suffix/prefix overlap with a three-level tie-break and substring/containment absorption) must be implemented precisely or hidden cases diverge. hidden_case_generalization=2: the reusable tool must produce identical results on 5 unseen FASTA inputs including empty, single-read, contained-read and no-overlap scenarios, not just the visible case. quantitative_correctness=2 because a wrong greedy outcome deterministically fails exact string comparison. Medium bucket (total 10).
